owned_invariants: A body over MAX_JSON_BYTES gets 413 before parsing.
boundaries: The JavaScript page only renders core output; it computes no protocol value.

score.level_basis: Stateless HTTP API and page server with chunked, capped body reads, typed error responses, an asset allow-list, and a loopback-by-default bind rule enforced before the server starts.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: inputs are admitted by strict Pydantic models before use (RULE_PY_001) and outputs are typed; behaviour matches the documented contract in the module docstring and README. Not B: the static page's JavaScript is outside the Python profile and was checked by hand in a browser, not by an automated UI test.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. TestClient contract tests for every status code; bind-rule tests with uvicorn replaced. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 3, cognitive 4, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
